annotations.text:
The problem, measured: today's window is 720px tall and the content runs to ~1580px. Settings and the gallery — the two things added most recently — sit entirely below the fold.

Both directions keep the same tokens, type and density as the shipped app. They differ in where things live.

A — Cockpit + tabs

State, buffer and the two actions stay pinned at the top; Status / Library / Settings become destinations below.

Tradeoff: settings are a click away rather than a scroll, but you can no longer see health and library at once.

Clickable: switch tabs, flip Clips/Recordings, click a row to open the player, toggle the mic and mix switches.

B — One screen

No navigation at all. A dial carries state and buffer together, recent clips sit as a filmstrip, and everything else folds into accordion rows — one open at a time.

Tradeoff: nothing is more than one click deep and the last clip is always visible, but a long settings list still scrolls once opened.

Clickable: open and close each section.
